mentions.name: 8BitSmith
mentions.description: A simple pixel art and sprite generator that produces quick sprites that can be dropped directly into a project, saving time when creating pixel art and animations.
mentions.problem: Pixel art animations tend to be very time consuming to create.
mentions.source_excerpt: I needed some pixel art for a different project, so I made 8BitSmith, a simple pixel art & sprite generator.

evidence.value: I needed some pixel art for a different project, so I made 8BitSmith, a simple pixel art & sprite generator.
